description: Model sources the host can hand to a Harness. Worldlet provides no model of its own (owner decision 2026-10-05; the `worldlet` model service source is retired), so the only source is `local-codex`, the person's own Codex sign-in on this computer, in every build; a personal source routes tiers only in a process the host started with it. The host chooses one source ID (WORLDLET_MODEL_SOURCE) and supplies its credential; the Harness maps each task tier to that source's model. Changing a model is an edit here, not in Harness code. A person's own provider (Codex account, API key, compatible endpoint) is configured in the Harness and is not listed here.
